fact: ZIMRA says it is introducing TaRMS for domestic taxes, under which taxpayers pay by bank transfer or deposit into a ZIMRA single account at their chosen bank, validated by the bank through its integration with TaRMS; customs payments stay on the old platform.
Justice Minister Ziyambi Ziyambi said applicants on the DLAP can pay deed fees electronically under the Gazette's Fourth Schedule or by the manual process in the Second Schedule.

ZIMRA Public Notice 75 of 2024 says taxpayers file returns online through the Self-Service Portal and pay VAT, PAYE, income, withholding and presumptive taxes into the ZIMRA bank account by cash deposit or bank transfer from linked bank accounts, posted in TaRMS.
ZIMRA says the TaRMS Payments Management and Return Management modules were launched on 6 December 2023.

ZINARA introduced a multi-currency e-wallet platform (iOS, Android, web, USSD) on which motorists pay toll fees, vehicle licensing, ZBC radio licences and third-party insurance, per ZINARA's emailed response.
Statutory Instrument 153 of 2023 defines the Judicial Service Commission's IECMS as the platform on which High Court litigants pay court fees electronically.
